sentences.text_target: Mark decided to book a consultation because his health concerns were increasing.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːrk dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː bʊk ə ˌkɒnslˈteɪʃn bɪˈkɒz hɪz hɛlt kənˈsɜːnz wɜːr ɪnˈkriːsɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Mark a décidé de prendre un rendez-vous de consultation parce que ses problèmes de santé s'aggravaient.

sentences.text_target: His symptoms had worsened gradually over the past week.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈsɪmptəmz hæd ˈwɜːrsənd ˈɡrædʒuəli ˈəʊvər ðə pɑːst wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Ses symptômes s'étaient aggravés progressivement au cours de la semaine précédente.

sentences.text_target: He experienced a persistent cough and unusual exhaustion.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɪkˈspɪəriənst ə pəˈsɪstənt kɒf ænd ʌnˈjuːʒuəl ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il souffrait d'une toux persistante et d'une fatigue inhabituelle.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, he phoned his local medical practice early in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðeəfɔːr, hiː fəʊnd hɪz ˈləʊkl ˈmɛdɪkl ˈpræktɪs ˈɜːli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, il a téléphoné à son cabinet médical de quartier tôt le matin.

sentences.text_target: The receptionist greeted him politely and asked about his availability.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ˈɡriːtɪd hɪm pəˈlaɪtli ænd ɑːskt əˈbaʊt hɪz əˌveɪləˈbɪləti/
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste l'a accueilli poliment et s'est renseignée sur ses disponibilités.

sentences.text_target: She checked the computer system to find an open slot.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː tʃɛkt ðə kəmˈpjuːtə ˈsɪstəm tuː faɪnd ən ˈəʊpən slɒt/
sentences.text_native: Elle a consulté le système informatique pour trouver un créneau libre.

sentences.text_target: Fortunately, a practitioner had a cancellation for that afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfɔːtʃənətli, ə prækˈtɪʃənər hæd ə ˌkænsəˈleɪʃən fɔːr ðæt ˌɑːftəˈnuːn/
sentences.text_native: Heureusement, un praticien avait eu un désistement pour l'après-midi même.

sentences.text_target: Mark agreed immediately because the timing was very convenient.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːrk əˈɡriːd ɪˈmiːdiətli bɪˈkɒz ðə ˈtaɪmɪŋ wɒz ˈvɛri kənˈviːniənt/
sentences.text_native: Mark a accepté immédiatement, car l'horaire lui convenait parfaitement.

sentences.text_target: He arrived at the facility ten minutes before his scheduled time.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː əˈraɪvd æt ðə fəˈsɪlɪti tɛn ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔːr hɪz ˈskɛdjuːld taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Il est arrivé à l'établissement dix minutes avant l'heure prévue.

sentences.text_target: While sitting in the waiting area, he completed a brief medical questionnaire.
sentences.phonetic: /waɪl ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈeəriə, hiː kəmˈpliːtɪd ə briːf ˈmɛdɪkl ˌkwɛstʃəˈnɛər/
sentences.text_native: Assis dans la salle d'attente, il a rempli un bref questionnaire médical.

sentences.text_target: Soon after, a nurse called his name and guided him inside.
sentences.phonetic: /suːn ˈɑːftər, ə nɜːs kɔːld hɪz neɪm ænd ˈɡaɪdɪd hɪm ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Peu après, une infirmière a prononcé son nom et l'a fait entrer.

sentences.text_target: She measured his vital signs including temperature and blood pressure.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛʒərd hɪz ˈvaɪtl saɪnz ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ ˈtɛmprətʃər ænd blʌd ˈprɛʃər/
sentences.text_native: Elle a mesuré ses constantes vitales, notamment sa température et sa tension artérielle.

sentences.text_target: Everything seemed relatively normal, but further checking was necessary.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ siːmd ˈrɛlətɪvli ˈnɔːml, bʌt ˈfɜːðər ˈtʃɛkɪŋ wɒz ˈnɛsəsəri/
sentences.text_native: Tout semblait relativement normal, mais des examens complémentaires étaient nécessaires.

sentences.text_target: The doctor entered the office and shook hands warmly with Mark.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktər ˈɛntərd ðə ˈɒfɪs ænd ʃʊk hændz ˈwɔːmli wɪð mɑːrk/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin est entré dans le cabinet et a serré la main de Mark chaleureusement.

sentences.text_target: They sat down so Mark could thoroughly explain his discomfort.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ sæt daʊn səʊ mɑːrk kʊd ˈθʌrəli ɪksˈpleɪn hɪz dɪsˈkʌmfərt/
sentences.text_native: Ils se sont assis pour que Mark puisse décrire en détail ce qui le faisait souffrir.

sentences.text_target: The physician listened carefully without interrupting the explanation.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fɪˈzɪʃn ˈlɪsnd ˈkɛəfəli wɪˈaʊt ˌɪntəˈrʌptɪŋ ði ˌɛkspləˈneɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a écouté attentivement sans l'interrompre.

sentences.text_target: Then, he performed a thorough physical examination of the chest.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn, hiː pəˈfɔːrmd ə ˈθʌrəli ˈfɪzɪkl ɪɡˌzæmɪˈneɪʃən ɒv ðə tʃɛst/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il a procédé à un examen physique approfondi du thorax.

sentences.text_target: He used a stethoscope to listen carefully to the patient's breathing.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː juːzd ə ˈstɛθəskəʊp tuː ˈlɪsn ˈkɛəfəli tuː ðə ˈpeɪʃənts ˈbriːðɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a utilisé un stéthoscope pour écouter attentivement la respiration du patient.

sentences.text_target: The doctor noticed a minor infection in the upper airways.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktər ˈnəʊtɪst ə ˈmaɪnər ɪnˈfɛkʃən ɪn ði ˈʌpər ˈeəweɪz/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a détecté une infection bénigne des voies respiratoires supérieures.

sentences.text_target: To investigate further, he decided to order a blood test.
sentences.phonetic: /tuː ɪnˈvɛstɪɡeɪt ˈfɜːðər, hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɔːrdər ə blʌd tɛst/
sentences.text_native: Pour approfondir le diagnostic, il a décidé de prescrire une prise de sang.

sentences.text_target: The nurse returned quickly to take a small blood sample.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə nɜːs rɪˈtɜːnd ˈkwɪkli tuː teɪk ə smɔːl blʌd ˈsɑːmpl/
sentences.text_native: L'infirmière est revenue rapidement pour prélever un petit échantillon de sang.

sentences.text_target: This sample would go to the laboratory for detailed analysis.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsɑːmpl wʊd ɡəʊ tuː ðə ləˈbɒrətəri fɔːr ˈdiːteɪld əˈnæləsɪs/
sentences.text_native: Cet échantillon a été envoyé au laboratoire pour une analyse approfondie.

sentences.text_target: Afterwards, the doctor provided clear reassurance about the recovery process.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftəwərdz, ðə ˈdɒktər prəˈvaɪdɪd klɪər ˌriːəˈʃʊrəns əˈbaʊt ðə rɪˈkʌvəri ˈprəʊsɛs/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, le médecin s'est voulu très rassurant quant au processus de guérison.

sentences.text_target: He wrote a prescription for targeted antibiotics and soothing cough syrup.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː rəʊt ə prɪˈskrɪpʃən fɔːr ˈtɑːɡɪtɪd ˌæntibaɪˈɒtɪks ænd ˈsuːðɪŋ kɒf ˈsɪrəp/
sentences.text_native: Il lui a rédigé une ordonnance pour des antibiotiques ciblés et un sirop calmant pour la toux.

sentences.text_target: Mark needed to take the medication strictly according to instructions.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːrk ˈniːdɪd tuː teɪk ðə ˌmɛdɪˈkeɪʃən ˈstrɪktli əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tuː ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Mark devait suivre scrupuleusement la posologie indiquée pour son traitement.

sentences.text_target: Additionally, strict rest at home was strongly recommended for several days.
sentences.phonetic: /əˈdɪʃənəli, strɪkt rɛst æt həʊm wɒz ˈstrɒŋli ˈrɛkəmɛndɪd fɔːr ˈsɛvrəl deɪz/
sentences.text_native: De plus, un repos strict à domicile lui a été fortement conseillé pendant plusieurs jours.

sentences.text_target: Before leaving, Mark scheduled a follow-up appointment for the next week.
sentences.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔːr ˈliːvɪŋ, mɑːrk ˈskɛdjuːld ə ˈfɒləʊˌʌp əˈpɔɪntmənt fɔːr ðə nɛkst wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Avant de partir, Mark a pris un rendez-vous de suivi pour la semaine suivante.

sentences.text_target: He thanked the medical team and walked toward the pharmacy outside.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː θæŋkt ðə ˈmɛdɪkl tiːm ænd wɔːkt ˈtɔːwərd ðə ˈfɑːməsi ˈaʊtsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il a remercié l'équipe médicale et s'est dirigé vers la pharmacie la plus proche.

sentences.text_target: With the proper treatment plan, he expected to feel much better soon.
sentences.phonetic: /wɪð ðə ˈprɒpər ˈtriːtmənt plæn, hiː ɪkˈspɛktɪd tuː fiːl mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər suːn/
sentences.text_native: Grâce à ce traitement adapté, il espérait se sentir beaucoup mieux très bientôt.

sentences.text_target: His discharge from the clinic marked the beginning of his recovery.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz dɪsˈtʃɑːrdʒ frɒm ðə ˈklɪnɪk mɑːkt ðə bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ ɒv hɪz rɪˈkʌvəri/
sentences.text_native: Son départ de la clinique a marqué le début de sa convalescence.
